schema: CREATE INDEX pages_section ON pages(section_id, ordinal)
CREATE INDEX sections_chapter ON sections(chapter_id, session_pk, ordinal)
CREATE INDEX sessions_chapter ON sessions(chapter_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE chapters (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 task_id TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(project_id, task_id)
)
CREATE TABLE meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE pages (
 rid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 section_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 session_pk TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 chapter_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chapters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 title TEXT NOT NULL, question TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_refs TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL
)
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE pages_fts USING fts5(title, question, body, directory, tokenize='unicode61')
CREATE TABLE 'pages_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE 'pages_fts_content'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c0, c1, c2, c3)
CREATE TABLE 'pages_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'pages_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'pages_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE pages_stem_fts USING fts5(title, question, body, directory, tokenize='porter unicode61')
CREATE TABLE 'pages_stem_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE 'pages_stem_fts_content'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c0, c1, c2, c3)
CREATE TABLE 'pages_stem_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'pages_stem_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'pages_stem_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE sections (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_pk TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 chapter_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chapters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 title TEXT NOT NULL, summary TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE sessions (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, external_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 chapter_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chapters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 title TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 content_hash TEXT NOT NULL, raw_json TEXT NOT NULL, segmentation TEXT NOT NULL,
 message_count INTEGER NOT NULL, turn_count INTEGER NOT NULL, content_chars INTEGER NOT NULL,
 settings_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
 UNIQUE(project_id, external_id)
)

CREATE TABLE turns (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_pk TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, question TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, message_indices TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(session_pk, ordinal)
)
